request.prompt: Extend the ticket service with comments on tickets. `POST /tickets/:id/comments` with a JSON body `{"author": "<name>", "body": "<text>"}` adds a comment to the ticket and answers 201 with the comment, which has an `id`, the `author`, the `body` and when it was `created`. An author is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters and a body a non-empty text of at most 2000 characters. A ticket in any status except `closed` takes comments; a closed one answers 409. `GET /tickets/:id` shows the ticket's `comments`, oldest first, an empty list when it has none. When someone other than the agent a ticket is assigned to comments on it, that agent is notified of the comment. Comments are kept like the rest of a ticket's state: they survive a restart of the service, and a data file written before this change keeps loading. Everything the service already does keeps working, and its existing tests must still pass as they are. Add node:test tests under test/ for the new behaviour; `npm test` runs them with the existing ones.
